title: New institutions: constitutions and courts
goal: Read about the new constitutions of Brazil, Colombia and Paraguay and the new courts, using the se passive.

items: I can say what Brazil's constitution of 1988 recognised and what it created.
I can say what Colombia's constitution of 1991 created, including the tutela.
I can say what Paraguay's constitution of 1992 limited.
I can say what was created without naming who did it, with *se crearon tribunales*.
